tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Financial Bid of the tender for providing Man-Power Services: The bidder shall have to quote the service charge in the form of %(percentage). Service charge Percnetage shall be more than or equal to 2%. Service charge rate quoted between 0% and less than 2% will be summarily rejected and EMD of those tenderers are liable to be forfited
Mandatory contribution of EPF and ESIC by the agencies in timely manner
The Service provider / contractor shall be responsible for paying wages to contract labour at rates not less than the minimum wages as notified by the Appropriate Government
The service provider / contractor shall not make any unauthorized deductions from the wages of the contract labour

As per the contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act, 1970 the service provider/contractor shall be responsible for ensuring that wages are paid to the contract labour on time. The principal employer/buyer shall ensure that the wages are paid to the contract labour by the service provider / contractor. In case the service provider / contractor fails to pay the wages on time or makes short payment, the principal employer / buyer shall be liable to pay the wages to the contract labour directly and recover the amount from the service provider / contractor
The service provider / contractor shall be responsible for paying bonus to contract labour in the manner prescribed by the Payment of Bonus Act, 1965 and shall get reimbursed by the buyer

The service provider / contractor shall be responsible for paying proportionate gratuity to contract labour who have rendered continuous service as per the provisions of the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972

Self-Attestation Mandatory: Every uploaded document must be duly self-attested with the official seal and authorized signature of the bidder on every page. Unsigned or unsealed uploads are liable for rejection
Bidders must ensure that all relevant supporting documents are uploaded strictly against the specific technical eligibility criteria designated on the e-procurement portal
All other terms and conditions as per tender document
